title: Application of Boston Edison Company for approval by the Department of Public Utilities under G.L. c. 164, § 14, of a financing plan for the issuance, from time to time on or prior to December 31, 1996, of (i) long-term debt securities, (ii) shares of common stock, (iii) shares of cumulative preferred stock, and (iv) shares of preference stock, in an amount not to exceed $500,000,000; for an exemption from the advertising requirements of G.L. c. 164, § 15; and for an exemption from the par value requirements of G.L. c. 164, § 15A.
